'''Darth Vich''' was a young [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] when his [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] launched a [[Great Galactic War|war]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Shortly after its [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|beginning]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vich went to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] and defied a [[Millennium/Legends|one-thousand-year]] [[Speciesism|anti-alien]] tradition to transform a hundred [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] tribes into his [[Darth Vich's army|personal army]]. Vich was eager to elevate his own status in the Empire in an unsuccessful [[Darth Vich's insurrection|ploy]]. The Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] then [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] or [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Sith Lord's Rattataki followers, and rumors that some of his Rattataki [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]] betrayed him and were then admitted for full [[Sith training]] circulated.

==Biography==
When the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]] was preparing the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] for war against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]],<ref name="HN Empire">{{Holonet|allegiances|sith-empire|The Sith Empire}}</ref> the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] were composed of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith purebloods]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> Among their [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] was a young person who became known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vich, serving under the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]]<ref name="HN Rattataki" /> by [[3681 BBY]].<ref name="War date">{{HolonetOld|inhabitants|rattataki|Rattataki}} indicates that Vich was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] when the [[Great Galactic War]] began. The conflict began in [[3681 BBY]], according to ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]''.</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Sith Empire revealed itself to the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] and [[Assault on the Tingel Arm region|invaded]] the Republic's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], sparking the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="Timeline 6">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref>

[[File:KaliyoDjannis-TOR.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Vich dismissed the Sith Empire's anti-alien taboo to build a personal army of Rattataki (pictured).]]
In the early stages<ref name="HN Rattataki" /> of the twenty-eight-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] conflict,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> the arid [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Rattatak/Legends|Rattatak]] in the deep Outer Rim came to the attention of Vich. The Sith Lord was intrigued by its inhabitants, the [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]], who had become a fierce warrior people after generations of infighting and countless struggles for survival on the bleak world. Recognizing their potential and dismissing a [[Millennium/Legends|one-thousand-year]] [[Speciesism|anti-alien]] tradition, Vich recruited hundreds of Rattataki tribes from the world into his [[Darth Vich's army|personal army]]. His forces were formidable opponents in battle, and he discovered that dozens of his [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Vich took the Force-sensitive Rattataki and trained them as [[Sith acolyte/Legends|acolytes]].<ref name="HN Rattataki" />

Vich later used his Rattataki [[Army/Legends|army]] in a [[Darth Vich's insurrection|play for power]] that ultimately failed, and he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the Empire.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Following the attempt, Vich's Rattataki followers were either [[Death/Legends|executed]] or [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the Dark Council. Rumors persisted that a number of Rattataki acolytes had betrayed Vich during his insurrection and were later taken in by the Sith for full training.<ref name="HN Rattataki" /> In the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|period]] following the initial war against the Republic,<ref name="HN Rattataki" /> the Empire began to allow non-Humans and non&ndash;Sith purebloods to undergo Sith training at the re-established [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|academy]] on the Outer Rim planet [[Moraband|Korriban]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Personality and traits==
Vich was a Force-sensitive<ref name="HN Rattataki" /> Human or Sith pureblood<ref name="Species" /> who attained the position of Sith Lord at a young age, eager to make a name for himself. He had the ambition and boldness to attempt a power play within the Sith Empire following its invasion of Republic space, dismissing one thousand years of anti-alien customs to exploit the Rattataki people. He organized a personal army and trained dozens of its members as acolytes of his own.<ref name="HN Rattataki" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Vich was created as part of the historical lore in the setting of the [[LucasArts]] and [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He was first mentioned on the game's official site as part of [[The Holonet]] feature.<ref name="HN Rattataki" />
